text: On the authority of Abu Hurairah - may God be pleased with him - he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: If it is Friday, the angels stand at the door of the mosque, writing down the first, then the first, and the likeness of the one who migrates (i.e., the early one) is like the one who sacrifices a camel, then like the one who sacrifices a cow, then a ram, then a hen, then an egg. When the imam comes out, they fold their newspapers, and listen to the dhikr.
